what: While the large photo box enters the screen (box top from the bottom of the screen to the middle), it unfolds from 0.8x to 1x in width around one corner, while the photo inside goes back from 1.2x to 1x, so the photo doesn’t look stretched and only the frame opens. Then, while the box leaves through the top of the screen, the inner photo slowly moves down by 20% of the box height (parallax) — all linear and tied to scroll

options.from: Horizontal scale at which spreading starts, default .8 — the inside returns from 1.2, close to 1/from (counter)
options.origin: Axis corner — left (default)·right. Use the side with the pinned small photo as the axis
options.drift: Distance the inner part moves down while exiting (% of box height), default 20 — 0 means no parallax
options.wide: Applied only at this width or wider (px), default 1024 — 0 means on phones too
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Inner photo panel (child, required) — make it 110% taller than the cell so no gap shows when it moves down. The cell needs overflow: hidden

from.where: index.html·about.html .od-method (big vertical videos for Method·People — original MediaWithSticky: column scaleX .8→1 · inner scaleX 1.2→1 (top bottom→top center) · inner yPercent 0→20 (top top→bottom top), 1024 and up)

note: The original shrinks the cell’s parent column (including the gap beside it) — this part shrinks the element it is attached to. You may attach it to the whole column to get the same look
